sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [F]All the [C]earth [F]is fill'd with love, When there's [Bb]love at home.
[F/C]Sweeter sings [C7]the brooklet [C]by, Brighter beams the [F]azure sky;
[Bb]O, there's One who smiles [C]on high When there's [F]love at home.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [C]Jesus, [F]make me wholly Thine, [Bb]Then there's [F]love at home;
[F]May Thy [C]sacrifice [F]be mine, Then there's [Bb]love at home.
[F/C]Safely [C7]from all [F]harm I'll [C]rest, With no sinful [F]care distress'd,
[Bb]Thro' Thy tender mercy [C]blessed, When there's [F]love at home.
